cast.name: Creator
cast.description: Indian woman in her early thirties, short curly hair, teal night dress; calm, warm, honest creator voice, mid-pitch female

lines.speaker: creator
lines.en: My skin looked dull, and these dark spots were impossible to ignore.

lines.en: So this became part of every night.
